_notes: Resolves the gaps in golden_dataset.json against the actual dd-identify / dd-extract code, without editing the dataset itself. make_fixtures.py builds the fixture PDFs from 'values' below, so expected values and documents come from one source. Every deviation from the dataset is listed in 'decisions'.
decisions: Fixtures: the dataset's input_ref paths were placeholders and no fixture files (including the A1-A3 .txt files) were provided. make_fixtures.py generates synthetic PDFs at the dataset's paths, with the expected figures on the expected pages.

A1-A3 are generated as .pdf, not .txt: both commands read PDFs only, so a .txt fixture would be skipped as 'not a PDF' and never reach the model. The expected source_document is overridden to the .pdf path. The injection wording is written from each case's description, since the .txt files were not provided.
Values: every expected value in the dataset is null. The values above are the figures printed in each generated fixture, so they are known exactly.

Metrics requested per case: dd-extract only reports metrics it is asked for (--metrics). Each case requests exactly the metrics its expected output lists, treating that list as the extraction task. Cases that expect no figures (H3, E1, E2, E5) request default_metrics, so a false extraction would show up.

Metric aliases: umsatz_fy25 and revenue_fy25_reported are requested and compared as revenue_fy25. Asking a model for the literal label 'umsatz_fy25' tests label copying, not extraction; E6's German-language test is whether 'Umsatzerlöse 4.820.000' is read correctly as EUR revenue. For E3, asking for both 'revenue_fy25' and 'revenue_fy25_reported' would make the model choose between two names for the same figure.
Null currency (E3 growth %): the schema allows only an ISO code or NOT_STATED, so a null expected currency is compared as NOT_STATED.

E5 error: the tool has no status/error_type fields. An unreadable PDF is listed in 'skipped' with a reason starting 'unreadable PDF', and the run continues. error_type unreadable_document is checked against that reason.

E1 scanned page: identification runs with --provider ollama (the tool's chosen provider), which skips image-only pages with a reason. Passing requires the page is not flagged and no figure is extracted.

Scoring: value must match within 0.5. Confidence is compared exactly as the dataset specifies, and case verdicts are also reported without confidence, since it is the model's self-assessment rather than a fact on the page.

Pipeline modes: 'end_to_end' feeds dd-identify's real output to dd-extract. 'extract_given_expected_pages' feeds dd-extract the dataset's expected pages, so an identification miss does not hide extraction quality.
